0022600105.text: The Nets (0-1, 10th in the East and 4th in the Atlantic, 1 game back) have lost their only game so far, while the Cavaliers have yet to play a 2026-27 game. Brooklyn is without Tyler Bilodeau, who is day-to-day with a shoulder injury and a game-time decision. In 2025-26 the Nets lost all three meetings with Cleveland, most recently 106-102 in Brooklyn on March 1, 2026.
